mapper.select: SELECT FRMHS_NO, LSTKSP_CL, BRD_HAD_CO, LAST_CHANGE_DT FROM TN_MOBILE_BLVSTCK_HIST WHERE FRMHS_NO = #{farmId} AND LSTKSP_CL = #{speciesCode} AND LAST_CHANGE_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) ORDER BY LAST_CHANGE_DT DESC
SELECT FRMHS_NO FROM TN_BLVSTCK WHERE FRMHS_NO IN ( SELECT VF.FRMHS_NO FROM VIEW_FRMHS VF, TN_MOBILE_FRMHS_INFO@M2MSYS TMFI WHERE VFFDB_FRMHS_SN = TMFI.FDB_FRMHS_SN AND TMFI.FRMHS_NO = #{farmId} )

SELECT TFNM.CNTC_FRMHS_NO FROM TN_FRMHS@DL_LSFARM TF, TN_FARMHS_NO_MAPNG@DL_LSFARM TFNM WHERE TF.FRMHS_SN = TFNM.FRMHS_SN AND TF.USE_AT = 'Y' AND TFNM.USE_AT = 'Y' AND TFNM.INSTT_SE_CODE = '03' AND TF.FRMHS_SN = ( SELECT FDB_FRMHS_SN FROM VIEW_FRMHS WHERE FRMHS_NO = #{farmId} )
SELECT FARM_NO, FARM_NM, BRD_OWNER_NM, FRMHS_STTUS_CODE, RE_PREARNGE_DE, UPDT_DE FROM EAI_TN_FARM_INFO WHERE FARM_NO = #{farmId}
SELECT FARM_NO, UPPER_PRDLST_CODE, BRD_CO, MGR_CODE, EXAMIN_MTH_CODE, EXAMIN_DE, UPDT_DE FROM EAI_TN_FARM_SCALE WHERE FARM_NO = #{farmId} ORDER BY UPDT_DE DESC

SELECT FARM_NO, UPPER_PRDLST_CODE, SPCIES_CODE, SEQ_SN, BRD_CO, AVG_CNT, MXMM_BRD_CO, MOTHER_PIG_CO, PORKER_CO, MGR_CODE, KEEP_CODE, EXAMIN_DE, UPDT_DE FROM EAI_TN_FARM_SCALE_DETAIL WHERE FARM_NO = #{farmId}
